quantity: Free thermal contraction of the inner line, 300 K to the boiling temperature
required_input: linear thermal expansion (integrated, 300 K to 77 K) and elastic modulus of the material (UI-34)
equation: dL/L = integral of alpha(T) dT from 300 K to the boiling temperature
note: no expansion data with verified reuse terms are held; the length, route and material are also unresolved (UI-21, UI-25)

quantity: Movement of the inner line relative to the warm jacket
required_input: linear thermal expansion (integrated, 300 K to 77 K) and elastic modulus of the material (UI-34)
equation: equal to the free contraction of the inner line
note: the movement capacity of bellows or loops is vendor data (UI-24)

quantity: Restraint stress and force if the line were fully restrained (bound)
required_input: linear thermal expansion (integrated, 300 K to 77 K) and elastic modulus of the material (UI-34)
equation: sigma = integral of E(T) alpha(T) dT; force = sigma x section area
note: no allowable stress is available either (UI-25)

quantity: Heat conduction through supports and spacers, per metre of line
required_input: thermal conductivity of the support and line material, 77 K to 300 K (UI-35)
equation: Q' = n (A/L) integral of k(T) dT
note: the support design is also unresolved (UI-24); the heat-leak totals therefore exclude it and are lower bounds

quantity: Heat to remove from the metal of the line and fittings on cooldown
required_input: specific heat of the material, 77 K to 300 K, and the masses (UI-21, UI-28, UI-35)
equation: Q = m integral of cp(T) dT
note: liquid use per megajoule is available in cryogenic_cooldown.csv
